title: Bildwelt / traveler header
slide_intent: Place a person within a believable environment so viewers can relate the image to lived travel.
strategic_value: A natural moment at a station can make DB’s world feel concrete and human.
demonstration: A wide photograph shows a woman holding a phone at a station, with directional light and the building behind her.
practical_value: Inspect how portrait, setting and light share the frame without a posed advertising gesture.

content_islands.name: Traveler
content_islands.spec: Place the woman and phone prominently in the foreground.

content_islands.name: Station context
content_islands.spec: Retain the roof and station structure behind her.

reference_purposes.Expression: The photograph combines a traveler, real station setting and directional light.
